name: replaceFeatures ignored: the base definition's features leak into the Relationships button
why: Without it the recording's Relationships render inherits recording-releases' features (Relationships injected column, CAA, MB-Name extraction, release columns). The spec asserts none of those headers appears.
grep: release columns do not leak in

name: removeMain off: the main data section stays beside the relationship tables
why: Either/or (user decision 2026-10-12). With the releases table left in, it is the first table.tbl on the page: the render anchors to its h2 and the spec sees 'Appears on releases' still present.

name: the button's own pageType is not switched to
why: Without the switch the render runs as recording-releases, whose pageType-keyed branches act on the relationship tables. A saved file then records 'recording-releases' too, so the round trip loads it through the base definition (no converter) and the groups differ.

name: a disk load never activates the saving button
why: The file records 'recording-relationship-tables'; on a fresh recording page the load must run as that button. Without the activation the pageType check stops at a mismatch dialog and nothing renders.

name: the date attributes are not taken off the line
why: Begin/End stay empty and the dates stay in the text: the spec pins Begin/End per row and the B-/E- date parts.

name: the per-group extractor re-resolution skips relationship-tables renders
why: Begin/End sit at a different index in every group; resolved once, the B-/E- columns come out empty or from the wrong column.

name: a place's date stays in its Area cell
why: MusicBrainz prints a place relationship's date after the area chain; _eventRelParseLine() puts it in `area`.

name: Number and Order always one column
why: User decision 2026-10-12: two columns as soon as one row's number and order differ (the artist's Super Bowl row: number 43, order 19).

edits.find: const numOrderSplit = rows.some(r => r.number && r.order && r.number !== r.order);

name: an ended URL relationship is not read as a URL
why: It has no link natively (span.deleted); unread, it lands in an 'Other' group with its date in the target text.

name: Picard's release-link guard accepts any href containing /release/
why: The old guard: discogs.com/release/… and rateyourmusic.com/release/… gave URL tables a Picard column.

name: release credits read as everything under the Credits h2
why: The release's own lists are found by #release-relationships. Reading every table.details of #bottom-credits instead would merge the release group's lists into the release's own groups (and, in the 'at bottom' layout, every track credit).

name: the existing main button converts the relationship lists too
why: User decision 2026-10-12: the page's own 'Show all…' button renders as before, the native lists staying a collapsible section. Converting them on that press changes its output.

edits.replace:
applyRelDetailsToTables({ features: { relDetailsToTables: { relatedH2: 'h2.related-works' } } });

        // ── sidebarToTables pre-processing

name: a primary alias stays in the disambiguation
why: MusicBrainz prints it inside span.comment as <i title="Primary alias">; unread, 'Fujipacific Music, Inc.' is the row's Disambiguation and no Primary alias column exists.

edits.find: const al = opts.rel ? c.querySelector('i[title="Primary alias"]') : null;

name: a date leading an attribute group is not read
why: '(from 1964-12 until 1965-06: lead vocals, electric guitar)' ends in a link, so only the leading-date pass sees the period; without it the date is a Credits row and Begin/End stay empty.

name: More Flags' wrapped comma stays in the target
why: The ', ' before the parent chain sits inside span.mfe-flag-wrapper; left there the chain starts without a comma and lands in Details.

name: Genre and Instrument have no header glyph
why: Without them in _eventColGlyphs() the header gets no glyph and every cell keeps its own.

name: no inline cover art / event art on the relationship tables
why: addCAA/addEAA name the target columns; without them no placeholder is injected.

name: the artwork link scan is not column-scoped on relationship tables
why: Not visible to the inline-placeholder test, which reads per-row links (inlineLinkSel) and never this selector. The scope matters only to the big-image strips' counts (_artCountLinks), which no fixture spec here opens; recorded so the gap is known.

name: the event page keeps series positions in Details
why: WIP.7 gives the event page the attrs columns; without them '(order: 150)' stays in Details.
grep: each part of a target line

name: the @include line does not admit /url/<mbid>
why: The fixture harness injects the script unconditionally, so only the header test sees an unreachable url-overview.

name: the url-overview pageType is missing
why: Without it a URL page gets no button at all.

name: Target/Type cells carry no entity type
why: Without data-mb-entity-type the "Entity info - Type" section has nothing to count and never appears.

name: an "Entity info - Type" entry never filters
why: Rendered and counted but unmatched: the tick must leave exactly the rows of that kind.

name: "Entity info - Type" entries carry no glyph
why: The entry's marker slot must show the kind's MusicBrainz glyph.

name: the render gates ignore the entity-type counts
why: Both render gates decide whether the panel builds its synthetic sections at all; without the entity-type counts in them the section never renders and the spec sees it missing.
